steps.title: Phrases
steps.body: Use a short weather phrase, then give a temperature or condition. You can also name the clothes you wear or take when you go out.

steps.title: Say the whole block
steps.body: Learn these as blocks, exactly as you hear them. Say each one out loud. Tap the speaker to hear it.

steps.tip: Say it: eel feh frwah oh-zhoor-DWEE
Say it: eel feh mwa(n) va(n)t-sa(n)k duh-GRAY

steps.fr: Il y a du vent et de la neige.
steps.tip: Say it: eel yah dü vah(n) ay duh lah nezh
Say it: eel nezh suh mah-TA(N)

steps.en: I am wearing a winter coat.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh port uh(n) mah(n)-TOH dee-VEHR

steps.fr: Je prends ma tuque et mes mitaines.
steps.en: I take my tuque and mittens.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh pra(n) mah tük ay may mee-TEHN
Say it: luh troh-TWAHR eh glee-SAH(N)
Say it: eel pluh suh mah-TA(N)
